notes: Actual results for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2024, as the township reported them to the Census Bureau's Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances. Not a budget.
Public schools are run by separate school districts with their own taxes, so they are not included. Residents also pay Logan County.
Illinois townships maintain township roads, assess property and provide general assistance; most also cover the cities and villages inside them.
Covers every fund, including water, sewer, electric and other utilities. Debt service counts interest and principal repaid; borrowing and transfers between funds are left out.
Courts, legal services, public buildings, housing and community development count as overhead.
Debt is long-term debt outstanding plus short-term debt at year end.
Political money is not scored: State Board of Elections data was not loaded.
Transparency practices have not been checked yet, so they are not scored.
